Parent: #53 (Requirement 4)

## Goal
API primitives for a Dreamer process that promotes high-value agent memories into `collab` with provenance tracking, dedup, and reversal.

## Changes
- Migration: add `promoted_from JSONB` column to all core tables (provenance: source_namespace, source_id, source_agent, promotion_reason, promoted_at, promoted_by)
- New MCP tool `promote_entry` — copy entry to collab with dedup check (vector similarity + content_hash), return duplicate if exists
- New MCP tool `demote_entry` — archive promoted copy, clear provenance cross-reference
- New MCP tool `scan_namespace` — scan agent namespace entries, categorize as candidates/duplicates/already_promoted
- REST endpoints: `POST /api/v1/promote`, `POST /api/v1/demote`, `GET /api/v1/scan/:namespace`
- Auth: promote/scan = admin or n8n, demote = admin only

## Acceptance criteria
- Promote entry from `bilby` to `collab` preserves provenance metadata
- Repeated promotion of same entry returns `status: duplicate` with existing ID
- Demote archives the promoted copy
- Scan returns categorized entries with similarity scores against collab
- Companion rTech issue implements client against these APIs

## Depends on
#54 (namespace writes), #56 (REST API / service extraction)
